pages.title: The unit of separation
pages.text:
The unit of separation
Complete generated images remain in one split.
Neighboring patches from one image
share both pixels and geometry; splitting pixels would answer an easier prediction problem.

pages.title: Physical boundary distance
pages.text:
Physical boundary distance
Compute nearest-boundary distances in both directions using physical coordinates.
Average distance describes typical displacement; Hausdorﬀ distance records the largest
nearest-boundary discrepancy.

pages.title: Empty-set conventions
pages.text:
Empty-set conventions
Two empty masks have Dice one in this implementation. One empty mask has Dice zero.
Boundary distance is unavailable when only one boundary is empty.

pages.title: The downstream geometric requirement
pages.text:
The downstream geometric requirement
A transport model depends on the paths and boundaries of its domain.
An overlap score
cannot by itself certify preservation of those paths.
